scope: confirmatory benchmark infrastructure only; no solver-implementation claim

training.checkpoint_selection: validation selection only as implemented by finetune(); test metrics never select checkpoints

selection_rules: No method, seed, label budget, basis side, perturbation order, or Krylov depth may be changed after confirmatory test outcomes are inspected.
All neural checkpoints are selected only by validation behavior in the existing finetune implementation.
Report every declared method; failed or missing cells remain explicit rather than being dropped.
Report ID at every label budget for neural methods and OOD only at the maximum label budget, matching runner 19.
Classical methods are label-free and are evaluated once per test example on every declared split.
Compute accounting is stratified into offline training, reusable setup, and online query work; wall time alone is not treated as FLOP equality.
claim_boundary: This bounded synthetic 16x16 benchmark can compare declared methods under a frozen local protocol. It cannot establish universal superiority, real-molecule validity, quantum advantage, or strict FLOP equivalence.
